How the Site Describes the Platform

The site says its proprietary platform scans multiple exchanges in real time for price differences, identifies underpriced assets, sells at higher prices elsewhere, and compounds small gains.

AI and machine-learning tools are described as delivering real-time insights, and users set risk tolerance and goals to tune the strategy.
